verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys 'decoupled from user accounts' explicitly for 'AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts' (headless/non-interactive auth), and a CI check that flags new code-security issues in pull requests, indicating some automatable, non-interactive workflow. However there's no documented CLI, no example of running the full platform headlessly in a pipeline beyond the PR check, and OAuth-based MCP connection explicitly requires an interactive browser login. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI/headless mode, concrete CI/CD pipeline examples beyond the code-security PR check, and confirmation that MCP/agent workflows can run fully unattended without any interactive OAuth step.
